src_sentence: sacet punar anāgāmy anāśraveṇa dhyānena caturthena āsravaṃ vyavakīrṇaṃ (Sh 469, 1) bhāvayati, tasmin mṛdumadhyādhimātrādhimātrarādhimātratamabhāvite yathāyogaṃ pañcānāṃ śuddhāvāsānāṃ devānāṃ sa{ha}bhāgatāyām upasaṃpadyate, tadyathā Avṛheṣu , Atapaṣu, Sudṛśeṣu, Sudarśaneṣu, Akaniṣṭheṣu.

head: idam

target: sbyor ba mthar thug pa'i 'bras bu'i yid la byed pa skyes pa'i tshe na ni/ / 'di lta ste/ lus thams cad dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde bas ma khyab pa dang / khyab par bya ba cung zad kyang med do/ / sbyor ba mthar thug pa'i yid la byed pa skyes par 'gyur ba'i tshe na ni lan 'ga' ni bde ba'i dngos po chung ngu'i tshul gyis khyab par byed do/ / lan 'ga' lan 'ga' ni bde ba'i dngos po shin tu mang po dang shin tu rgya chen po'i tshul gyis khyab par byed do/ / sbyor ba mthar thug pa'i 'bras bu'i yid la byed pa skyes par gyur pa'i tshe na ni 'di lta ste lus thams cad dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde bas khyab pa dang khyab par bya ba cung zad kyang med de/
src_sentence: pratanukasammukhībhāvayogena prayoganisthāmanaskārakāle spharati kadācit kadācid ghanavipulatarasammukhībhāvena prayoganisthāphale punar manaskāre vartamānasya nāsti kiñcid asphuṭam bhavati spharaṇīyaṃ sarvataḥ kāyād yaduta vivekājena prītisūkhena.

head: kāmāvacara
target: dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can/ bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag lnga bsgrubs te gnas pa dang / 'dod pa na spyod pa'i gnyen po'i lam bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu la gnas pa dang / 'dod pa rnams la 'dod chags dang bral ba thob pa zhes bya'o/ / ji ltar yid la byed pa bdun gyis bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par 'jug pa de bzhin du bsam gtan gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa dang gzugs med pa rnams la yang yid la byed pa bdun gyis snyoms par 'jug par ci rigs par rig par bya ste/
src_sentence: kāmāvacarapratipakṣamārgabhāvanāphale sthitaḥ kāmavairāgyatā anuprāptā ity ucyate.
